name: Cold Read Audit
purpose: Record comprehension, engagement, emotional response and confusion before analytical passes.
scope: Bounded writing_story capability; must operate on versioned structured artifacts.
out_of_scope: final approval outside owner decision rights
procedure: Validate authoritative inputs specifically required for cold_read_audit.
Execute the bounded operation: Record comprehension, engagement, emotional response and confusion before analytical passes.
Apply cold_read_audit-specific decision rules and record evidence/uncertainty.
Validate the named output against its workflow contract and creative invariants.
Record provenance and hand off to showrunner.
decision_rules: do not invent missing upstream decisions
prefer local repair over global rewrite when scope is local
escalate when confidence is low and impact is high
creative_invariants: preserve approved premise/theme/character/world/visual invariants unless work order explicitly authorizes change
examples: Run cold_read_audit on fixture/project artifact and emit a scored result.
counterexamples: Do not ask cold_read_audit to "make the whole film better" or override another department.
